description:
This process starts with a department outlining its objectives for the upcoming period, such as hiring, equipment needs, or marketing efforts.
The team drafts a plan that includes cost estimates and justifications for the budget requested.
The plan is first reviewed in a strategic alignment meeting to ensure it aligns with broader organizational goals.
Following this, the finance department performs a detailed review to assess the budget's feasibility.
The plan may undergo several rounds of review and possible adjustments based on feedback from these reviews.
Each adjustment is documented and approved by necessary stakeholders.
Once the final version of the budget is approved, the budget is officially allocated to the department.
The process ends when the budget is distributed, and the department begins implementing its plan.

                  id="Definitions_BudgetPlanning"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Budget planning begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Department outlines objectives"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Team drafts plan with cost estimates and justifications"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Finance reviews budget feasibility"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" name="Are adjustments needed?" default="Flow_NoAdjustments"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Stakeholders approve adjustment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Stakeholders approve final budget"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeBudget" name="Distribute budget"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementPlan" name="Department begins implementing plan"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Plan implementation begins"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outline_Draft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Strategic_FinanceReview" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finance_AdjustmentGateway" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdjustmentsNeeded" name="Adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustments are needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustments" name="No adjustments needed" sourceRef="Gateway_AdjustmentsNeeded" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Document_ApproveAdjustment" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveAdjustment_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Distribute" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_DistributeBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Distribute_Implement" sourceRef="Task_DistributeBudget" targetRef="Task_ImplementPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_ImplementPlan" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
